title: Solve Intelligence brings patent-specific AI capabilities to Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise for Legal
summary: Solve Intelligence is pleased to announce that it is a launch partner for Google Cloud’s Gemini Enterprise for Legal.
body_markdown:
Solve Intelligence is pleased to announce that it is a launch partner for Google Cloud’s Gemini Enterprise for Legal.


Through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) connector, Solve Intelligence is integrating its established patent research and analysis capabilities with Gemini Enterprise for Legal. The integration is designed to help legal teams access Solve Intelligence’s specialized patent tools and sources alongside Google Cloud’s enterprise workflows and information, creating an unmatched combination for purpose-built patent work.


The collaboration reflects a shared view: legal professionals benefit most when powerful enterprise AI is paired with deep, workflow-specific expertise.


> *"We’re incredibly excited to partner with Google by integrating Solve Intelligence into Gemini Enterprise for Legal on launch day. By integrating Solve with Gemini Enterprise, we are bringing the power of AI specialized for patent workflows wherever Solve customers might be working. This will be a huge benefit to practitioners using Solve for patent claim charting, SEP mappings, portfolio analysis, application drafting, prosecution, and more."*


- Chris Parsonson, Founder and CEO, Solve Intelligence


> *"Our goal with Gemini Enterprise for Legal is to meet practitioners where they work with trusted, powerful AI capabilities. Partnering with Solve Intelligence allows us to deliver specialized patent AI tools alongside Google Cloud’s enterprise-grade security and data privacy standards. Together, we’re helping enterprise IP teams make more informed decisions while keeping expert judgment at the center."*


- Satish Thomas, Vice President, Google Cloud


## **Key takeaways**


- IP teams on Gemini Enterprise for Legal can now run patent workflows through Solve Intelligence without leaving their Google Cloud environment.
- 700+ IP teams already run prior art, FTO, infringement, and SEP workflows on Solve Intelligence; all are now available inside Gemini Enterprise.
- No client data is ever used to train AI models; Solve Intelligence holds[SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certifications.](https://www.solveintelligence.com/security)
- Solve Intelligence is built to strengthen practitioner judgment on complex patent questions, not to replace it.
‍


### **Why patent AI needs domain expertise**


Legal work is not a single, general-purpose workflow. Each practice area relies on its own sources, terminology, procedures, professional standards, and forms of judgment.


Patent work is especially demanding. Practitioners must understand technically complex concepts, reason across large bodies of information, develop precise legal and technical positions, and produce work that can withstand scrutiny from patent offices, courts, clients, and opposing counsel.


General-purpose AI can assist with language and analysis, but effective support for intellectual property professionals requires tools designed around the realities of patent practice. That has been Solve Intelligence's focus from the start.


### **Bringing patent-specific workflows to Gemini Enterprise for Legal**


The integration is intended to support the patent workflows that intellectual property professionals run every day, including:


- **Prior-art and invalidity research:** *"Perform an invalidity search for US12345678B1."* Gemini Enterprise retrieves the patent's claims, searches global patent and non-patent literature for relevant prior art, and surfaces the strongest references with citations.


- **Freedom-to-operate:** *"Conduct an FTO search in China for the attached product."* Gemini Enterprise analyzes the product, generates targeted search strategies, and identifies patents that may be relevant to the proposed activity in that jurisdiction.


- **Infringement analysis:** *"Search for products that may infringe US12345678B1."* Gemini Enterprise combines patent claim analysis with web research to identify candidate products and articulate the infringement read.


- **Patent-law and case-law research:** " *Conduct a patentability search focusing on European and Japanese prior art for the attached invention disclosure."* Gemini Enterprise searches primary legal texts and case law in each jurisdiction and synthesizes a grounded comparative analysis.


- **Patent and claim analysis:** *"Analyze US12345678B1 and suggest potential §101 and §112 challenges."* Gemini Enterprise retrieves the patent, evaluates the claims and specification, and proposes substantive grounds for further review.


- **Standard-essential patent (SEP) mapping:** “ *Does claim 1 still read onto the H.266 technical standard?"* Gemini Enterprise pulls the relevant sections of the standard and maps each claim element against the technical specification.
‍


Solve Intelligence's established MCP capabilities are designed to work across the specialist sources patent teams rely on, including global patent literature; chemistry and life sciences sources; scientific and technical publications; patent legal texts and case law; and SEP technical documentation.


These are the same basic workflows that 700+ IP teams already run on Solve Intelligence, now accessible through a conversational interface backed by frontier-grade reasoning.


Users looking for Solve Intelligence’s full suite of drafting, prosecution, and claim charting tools will find those inside the[Solve platform](https://copilot.solveintelligence.com/) .


### **How Solve Intelligence supports professional judgment**


Solve Intelligence believes the most valuable legal AI systems will strengthen expert judgment rather than attempt to replace it.


Patent work involves strategic decisions shaped by technical understanding, legal experience, commercial context, and professional responsibility. AI can help practitioners search, organize, compare, draft, and reason across complex information. Meanwhile, the practitioner remains responsible for determining what is accurate, appropriate, and strategically sound.


That principle guides how Solve Intelligence builds its products and approaches this collaboration with Google Cloud.


#### **Security and trust by design**


Working with sensitive invention disclosures and privileged legal documents demands the highest security standards. Solve Intelligence is SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certified and adheres to ISO 42001, GDPR, EU AI Act, and CCPA requirements. No data uploaded to or generated by the Solve Intelligence platform is ever used to train any AI model. All data is encrypted with AES-256 and TLS 1.3, and customers choose where their data is stored and processed.


When Solve capabilities are accessed through Gemini Enterprise for Legal, security, access, and data handling will also depend on the customer's Google Cloud configuration and the applicable Google Cloud terms and policies.


### **Getting started**


Solve Intelligence is now available as an MCP connector in Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise for Legal.


**A few important details:**


- You will still need a Solve Intelligence subscription to connect Solve to Gemini Enterprise for Legal.
- The connector provides access to selected Solve capabilities. For the full patent workflow experience, including advanced drafting, prosecution, claim charting, and portfolio analysis, continue working in the Solve platform.
- Access permissions, security, data handling, and data locality within Gemini Enterprise for Legal will depend on your organization’s Google Cloud configuration, administrator settings, and the applicable Google Cloud terms and policies.
- For teams focused on patent work, Solve Intelligence remains the primary environment for the full set of patent-specific capabilities and end-to-end workflows. The Gemini Enterprise for Legal connector complements that experience by making selected Solve capabilities available within customers’ broader Google Cloud workflows.


To learn more about our platform, visit[solveintelligence.com](https://www.solveintelligence.com/) *or*[request a demo](https://www.solveintelligence.com/contact-us) *.*
